body: I think the "navigation conditions potentially changed" flag should be a property of the "navigable" instead of on the active document, declared [here](https://whatpr.org/html/11765/4b4492d...27be0e6/document-sequences.html#navigable). It should be associated with the ongoing navigation, which means we set it to false whenever we set the ongoing navigation is set / reset. Then in https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#dom-document-cookie mention that setting the cookie will set the flag to false, and add a note that other cookie-setting operations such as the Cookie Store API and setting non-HTTP only cookies via fetch can also set the flag to false.
